ctx.x: lot of the guys I talked to, whether for this program or not, it remains very clear to me that even, for instance, they said some of the people who had the fronts of being the most refined, like for instance, Benny Carter --

Oh, my goodness, man. He was worse than the rest of them because he was refined. See, a gentleman thug is worse than -- a conscious thug; he's refined. See, he's refined but he knows how to do that act better than the other one does because he knows what to do to you and where to hit you at. That isn't an element, but he knows what to do to you. Boom! (Inaudible) and you're knocked out. (Inaudible).

See, one of the greatest thugs you ever had (inaudible) Rudolph Chapman, Leroy Brown. See, Leroy Brown was in everything but fingernails -- Brown had his manicured, talking very soft and that time---- everything. He was that. At. But he knew that he had to do this.
